title: Build a configurable data pipeline: transform, filter, aggregate, format
description: Multi-step task: implement a 4-stage data pipeline in Python. Each stage builds on the previous. Tests for all stages are provided.

injections.content:
[project]
name = "python-pipeline"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
dependencies = ["pytest>=8.0", "ruff>=0.4"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
pythonpath = ["src"]
testpaths = ["tests"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100

from pipeline import transform_items, filter_items, aggregate, format_report


_RAW = [
    {"name": "  alice  ", "score": "85", "category": "A"},
    {"name": "BOB", "score": "72", "category": "B"},
    {"name": "Charlie", "score": "91", "category": "A"},
    {"name": "diana", "score": "60", "category": "B"},
]


# Stage 1: transform
def test_transform_normalizes_name():
    result = transform_items(_RAW)
    assert result[0]["name"] == "Alice"
    assert result[1]["name"] == "Bob"


def test_transform_converts_score_to_int():
    result = transform_items(_RAW)
    assert isinstance(result[0]["score"], int)
    assert result[0]["score"] == 85


# Stage 2: filter
def test_filter_by_min_score():
    items = transform_items(_RAW)
    result = filter_items(items, min_score=75)
    names = [r["name"] for r in result]
    assert "Alice" in names
    assert "Charlie" in names
    assert "Bob" not in names
    assert "Diana" not in names


def test_filter_by_category():
    items = transform_items(_RAW)
    result = filter_items(items, category="A")
    assert all(r["category"] == "A" for r in result)
    assert len(result) == 2


def test_filter_combined():
    items = transform_items(_RAW)
    result = filter_items(items, min_score=80, category="A")
    assert len(result) == 2
    assert all(r["score"] >= 80 and r["category"] == "A" for r in result)


# Stage 3: aggregate
def test_aggregate_basic():
    items = transform_items(_RAW)
    stats = aggregate(items)
    assert stats["count"] == 4
    assert stats["total"] == 85 + 72 + 91 + 60
    assert abs(stats["average"] - (85 + 72 + 91 + 60) / 4) < 0.01
    assert stats["max"] == 91
    assert stats["min"] == 60


def test_aggregate_empty():
    stats = aggregate([])
    assert stats["count"] == 0
    assert stats["total"] == 0
    assert stats["average"] == 0.0
    assert stats["max"] is None
    assert stats["min"] is None


# Stage 4: format_report
def test_format_report_contains_stats():
    items = transform_items(_RAW)
    stats = aggregate(items)
    report = format_report(stats)
    assert "count: 4" in report
    assert "total: 308" in report
    assert "max: 91" in report
    assert "min: 60" in report


def test_format_report_empty():
    stats = aggregate([])
    report = format_report(stats)
    assert "count: 0" in report

task_spec.prompt:
Create src/pipeline.py implementing a 4-stage data pipeline.

Stage 1 — transform_items(items: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
  For each item: strip+title-case 'name', convert 'score' from str to int. Return new list.

Stage 2 — filter_items(items: list[dict], *, min_score: int = 0, category: str | None = None) -> list[dict]:
  Keep items where score >= min_score AND (category is None OR item['category'] == category).

Stage 3 — aggregate(items: list[dict]) -> dict:
  Return {'count': N, 'total': sum, 'average': mean, 'max': max_score|None, 'min': min_score|None}.
  Empty list -> count=0, total=0, average=0.0, max=None, min=None.

Stage 4 — format_report(stats: dict) -> str:
  Return a multi-line string with one 'key: value' per line for count, total, average, max, min.
  Use integers for count/total/max/min; format average to 2 decimal places.

All 10 tests in tests/test_pipeline.py must pass.
Run: uv run pytest tests/ -v
required_artifacts: transform_items normalizes name to Title Case and score to int
filter_items supports min_score and category kwargs independently
aggregate handles empty list with None max/min
success_criteria: uv run pytest tests/ passes (10 tests)
uv run ruff check src/ passes
followup_prompts: Run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `uv run pytest tests/ -v` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
